notes.title: Update notes for June 21st
notes.content:
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Level timer will now record even if hidden
[*] The hat on level 72 will no longer kill you
[*] The elevator in level 93 no longer takes some of the wall with it
[*] Right CTRL and shift can now be used for abilities
[/list]
